boombox.why: Official Groene Boekje lemma is 'gettoblaster'; 'ghettoblaster' is not in the official list (spelling normalisation for an educational site).

dice.why: A PLURAL ('Dobbelstenen') is sitting in the singular field — the known defect. classification=countable-thing and the picture is one die, so the singular must be the count-noun singular 'dobbelsteen'.

lemur.why: Dutch spelling is 'lemuur' (double u), not 'lemur'; Groene Boekje: de lemuur

air-conditioning.why: classification=countable-thing (device). Current plural equalled the singular (no plural); GB gives meervoud airconditionings

banyan-tree.why: builder invention 'Waringinnen'; GB: de waringin, meervoud waringins

baobab-tree.why: builder invention 'Baobabben'; GB: de baobab, meervoud baobabs

basketball.why: picture=the ball; classification=countable-thing. GB: 'de basketbal' (bal, m) meervoud basketballen; current had no plural (sport treatment)

broccoli.why: cur p 'Broccoli' has no distinct plural; GB gives de broccoli → broccoli's, and classification hasPlural=true

cast.why: cur p 'Gips' has no distinct plural; GB gives het gips → gipsen, and classification hasPlural=true (twee gipsen)

chameleon.why: GB meervoud is 'kameleons', not the cur 'Kameleonen'

dragon-fruit.why: 'Drakenfruiten' is not standard — 'fruit' is a mass noun with no -en plural; exotic-fruit count plurals take -s in NL (kiwi's, mango's, drakenfruits). No image to cross-check.
dragon-fruit.src: native; fruit as mass per woordenlijst.org

durian.why: het Groene Boekje gives the plural as 'doerians', not 'doerianen'.

gopher.why: current plural 'Grondeekhoorns' is a DIFFERENT lemma (ground squirrel); plural of singular 'wangzakrat' is wangzakratten (rat → ratten)

ham.why: Groene Boekje: de ham, meervoud hammen (double m, short a). The image shows a countable ham joint and category = countable-thing; batch had no plural (p=s).

ice-cream.why: a countable ice cream pluralises as 'ijsjes' (twee ijsjes), never 'ijs'; het ijsje → ijsjes

iguanodon.why: Groene Boekje: de iguanodon → meervoud iguanodonten (not 'iguanodonnen')

jam.why: Groene Boekje: de jam (broodbeleg) → meervoud jams; current copied the singular

lantern.why: Groene Boekje: de lantaarn → meervoud lantaarns (not 'lantaarnen')

lavender.why: Groene Boekje lists only enkelvoud for 'de lavendel' (the plant/scent, mass); 'lavendels' occurs colloquially for varieties but is not standard

lightning.why: Groene Boekje lists de bliksem → meervoud bliksems (lightning flashes); the art shows several bolts. Dictionary wins over the mass-noun assumption

map.why: 'Mappen' is the plural of 'map' (folder/binder) — a false-friend error. The picture is a geographic map = de kaart, plural KAARTEN.

paper.why: Groene Boekje: het papier, meervoud papieren (category=countable-thing); huidige waarde herhaalt het enkelvoud

penguin.why: Groene Boekje geeft meervoud pinguïns; Pinguïnen is niet de standaardvorm

sky.why: for the sky/uitspansel sense the plural is 'hemelen'; 'hemels' is the plural of the baldakijn/canopy sense — wrong sense

sloth.why: Groene Boekje gives meervoud 'luiaards'; 'luiaarden' is not the listed plural

thunderstorm.why: Groene Boekje: het onweer, meervoud 'onweren'. The stored plural 'Onweer' just repeats the singular and is not a valid plural. NB: the brief lists 'Onweren' as a builder invention, but the official Groene Boekje lists onweren as the meervoud — the DICTIONARY WINS.

volleyball.why: current plural equals the singular (no plural). The ball is countable: Groene Boekje 'de volleybal' (bal) -> meervoud 'volleyballen' ('het volleybal' = the sport, no plural)

yak.why: current 'Yakken' is the plural of 'het jak' = the GARMENT. For the ANIMAL Groene Boekje gives 'de jak -> jaks' (Engelse -s), so 'yak -> yaks', NOT 'yakken'.

basketball.why: the pictured ball is 'de basketbal' (m); 'het basketbal' is only the SPORT. Football-trap analog: picture disambiguates to the ball -> de

hair-tie.why: Groene Boekje: HET haarelastiek (het elastiek). Batch had d.

tablet.why: Groene Boekje: the tablet COMPUTER is 'de tablet' (m), only het/de for the pill/slab sense. Picture is a device → de tablet, so g should be d not h.
